correctness.rationale: The orbit CW structure is valid because all simplex ranks are distinct and preserved. Full exact enumeration gives (22,114,204,116) cells, checks d^2=0, and integral unit eliminations (21,93,111) leave homology in degrees 0 and 3 only, of ranks one and five. EL-shellability gives simply connected cover. Two explicit reflection stabilizers generate D6, so Armstrong gives pi1 of quotient zero. Hurewicz and homological Whitehead then prove the claimed full five-S3 wedge. The exhaustive verifier is included and independently rerun from the delivered artifact.

value.rationale: The first chiral size n=6 is singled out by the published partition-orbit table (28 rotation and 24 full-dihedral classes, versus equality for n<=5). The complete five-S3 homotopy type of its proper-part quotient is a natural exact structural invariant, not inferred from that vertex count, from shellability of the cover, or from rational homology alone. This is a meaningful natural first-threshold classification, not an arbitrary narrow slice.
